description: Sri Lanka Institute of Architects - Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Regulations
reasoning: This gazette content involves the repeal and substitution of specific regulations (Nos. 9.3.4 (6), 9.3.5, 9.4, 10.1.1 and 10.1.3) under the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects Law, which constitutes legal/regulatory amendments. It details disciplinary procedures, membership fees, and registration requirements - all regulatory framework matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
